title: Judgment on Egypt

questions.question: Concerning the army of Pharaoh Neco, king of Egypt, which was defeated by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon at Carchemish by the river...?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 46:2 (ESV): "concerning the army of Pharaoh Neco, king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates at Carchemish and which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon defeated,"

questions.question: What commands does God facetiously give to the Egyptian soldiers as they prepare for battle?
options: "Prepare buckler and shield, and advance for battle!"
questions.correctAnswer: "Prepare buckler and shield, and advance for battle!"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 46:3 (ESV): "Prepare buckler and shield, and advance for battle!"

questions.question: Who is described as rising like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge, saying "I will rise, I will cover the earth, I will destroy cities and their inhabitants"?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 46:8 (ESV): "Egypt rises like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge. He said, 'I will rise, I will cover the earth, I will destroy cities and their inhabitants.'"

questions.question: Which nations' warriors are mentioned as fighting for Egypt in verse 9?
options: Cush, Put, and the men of Lud (Ludim)
questions.correctAnswer: Cush, Put, and the men of Lud (Ludim)
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 46:9 (ESV): "the warriors of Cush and Put who handle the shield, men of Lud, skilled in handling the bow."

questions.question: "That day is the day of the Lord God of hosts, a day of..., to avenge himself on his foes. The sword shall devour and be sated and drink its fill of their blood."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 46:10 (ESV): "That day is the day of the Lord God of hosts, a day of vengeance, to avenge himself on his foes."

questions.question: To where does the Lord tell the "virgin daughter of Egypt" to go up and take balm?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 46:11 (ESV): "Go up to Gilead, and take balm, O virgin daughter of Egypt!"

questions.question: Why does the Lord say it is in vain that the daughter of Egypt uses many medicines?
options: There is no healing for her
She refused to pay for them
questions.correctAnswer: There is no healing for her
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 46:11 (ESV): "In vain you have used many medicines; there is no healing for you."

questions.question: The word that the Lord spoke to Jeremiah about the coming of Nebuchadnezzar to strike the land of Egypt: "Declare in Egypt, and proclaim in... ; proclaim in Memphis and Tahpanhes..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 46:14 (ESV): "Declare in Egypt, and proclaim in Migdol; proclaim in Memphis and Tahpanhes;"

questions.question: Why has Egypt's mighty one fallen?
options: Because the Lord thrust him down
Because he fought against the true God
questions.correctAnswer: Because the Lord thrust him down
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 46:15 (ESV): "Why are your mighty ones face down? They do not stand because the Lord thrust them down."

questions.question: "Call the name of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, 'Noisy one who lets the... go by.'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 46:17 (ESV): "Call the name of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, 'Noisy one who lets the hour go by.'"

questions.question: "Like... among the mountains, like... by the sea, shall one come."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 46:18 (ESV): "Like Tabor among the mountains, and like Carmel by the sea, shall one come."

questions.question: "Egypt is a beautiful..., but a biting fly from the north has come upon her."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 46:20 (ESV): "A beautiful heifer is Egypt, but a biting fly from the north has come upon her."

questions.question: What does the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, say he is bringing punishment upon?
options: Amon of Thebes, and Pharaoh and Egypt and her gods and her kings
questions.correctAnswer: Amon of Thebes, and Pharaoh and Egypt and her gods and her kings
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 46:25 (ESV): "The Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, said: 'Behold, I am bringing punishment upon Amon of Thebes, and Pharaoh and Egypt and her gods and her kings, upon Pharaoh and those who trust in him.'"

questions.question: "But fear not, O Jacob my servant, nor be dismayed, O Israel, for behold, I will save you from afar, and your offspring from the land of their..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 46:27 (ESV): "for behold, I will save you from afar, and your offspring from the land of their captivity."

questions.question: What is the promise of peace for Jacob?
options: Jacob shall return and have quiet and ease, and none shall make him afraid
Jacob will rule over Egypt and Babylon
Jacob will become the wealthiest of nations
Jacob will conquer the whole earth
questions.correctAnswer: Jacob shall return and have quiet and ease, and none shall make him afraid
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 46:27 (ESV): "Jacob shall return and have quiet and ease, and none shall make him afraid."

key_verse_text: "But fear not, O Jacob my servant, nor be dismayed, O Israel, for behold, I will save you from afar, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob shall return and have quiet and ease, and none shall make him afraid."
